newsitem.title: POLAND: ZLOTY FIXED STRONGER AT 1.48 PCT FROM PARITY RATE.
newsitem.headline: ZLOTY FIXED STRONGER AT 1.48 PCT FROM PARITY RATE.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty unchanged at 3.1980 to the dollar and at 1.8795 to the mark, up from Wednesday's 1.8830, the NBP said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 1.48 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, stronger than Wednesday's 1.40 percent fix.
Polish markets were closed for Corpus Christi holiday on Thursday. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
